Company Description

Variosystems develops and manufactures electronic solutions for industries where reliability is critical - including Medtech & Life Science, Industrial & Automation, Aerospace & Defence and Smart Infrastructure & Environment. As a long-term strategic partner to innovators and market leaders, we offer services along the entire value chain, from concept and engineering to validated assemblies and global production. Across our global network, more than 2,800 people work together to transform ideas into reliable electronic systems.

Job Description

Purpose

Test Engineers are responsible for analyzing customer data, defining test strategy, calculating costs, design of test routines, developing software and hardware, implementation, and validating the test systems. They consult customers on matters relating to testability and design optimization and are responsible for selling their services.

Job Description

  • Analysis of customer data and requirements and definition of the test strategy.
  • Advising customers on test strategy and Design for Test (DFT) to achieve the most efficient and cost-effective testing solution.
  • End-to-end ownership of test development, from quotation through NPI completion, including system design, build coordination, debugging, and support until final release.
  • Development of customer-specific test concepts and creation of the required test routines, fixtures, and test systems.
  • Preparing fixture data and implementing additional hardware required for testing solutions.
  • Realization and implementation of various test technologies, including ICT, Flying Probe, Functional Testing, and Boundary Scan.
  • Development of application-specific test software.
  • Documentation of test solutions, including circuit diagrams, wiring lists, technical specifications, and related project documentation.
  • Collaborates with the other departments to ensure timely and successful completion of test projects, while considering technical feasibility and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Education and training of internal department colleagues, training of specialized personnel in the test field, promotion of innovation in the field of testing.
  • Collaboration with other Variosystems sites worldwide to share expertise, standardize solutions, and support global projects.

Qualifications

  • University – Bachelor's degree in engineering - electronics, electromechanics it is a plus
  • Proven track record in a similar position
  • English – Advanced / Intermediate
  • MS Office Package
  • SAP knowledge in this field of expertise
  • Tools and technologies: Spea Leonardo, Programming Language C#, Schematic Design in KiCAD, Jira
  • Good communication and organization skills
  • Strong attitude for teamwork, interpersonal skills and problem-solving
  • Hardware and software development know-how, general technical understanding, test automation, understanding of quality, problem solving skills, systems thinking, creativity, project management methods, communication skills

Additional Information

  • Flat hierarchies, direct communication, and a backbone of integrity, courage, responsibility.
  • A fast-moving environment where momentum is not lost in approval loops.
  • Collaborate with colleagues and customers across countries, industries, and perspectives.
  • A workplace shaped by technology, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  • Challenges with scale, depth, and enough complexity to keep you learning.
